name: Asao Masaharu
source:
An entirely ordinary salaryman who has been working for a medium-sized food company for four years.

His relationship with his girlfriend, Sayaka, began as a friendship during their university days, and they have now been dating for approximately six years.

His career is progressing smoothly, and his income has become relatively stable. Consequently, things have reached the point where he and Sayaka are beginning to feel that it may soon be time to get married.

During university, he secretly had feelings for Sayaka and followed her into the same university drama club. However, since he wasn't particularly interested in acting, he took charge of backstage work, such as constructing stage sets.

He is relatively enthusiastic when it comes to sex.

Although they have been dating for six years, his love for Sayaka remains strong, and he enjoys physical affection and spending intimate, affectionate time together with her.

His hobby is watching sports, and his dream is to someday purchase a season ticket for his favorite baseball team.

He is also an enthusiastic mahjong player and belongs to his company's mahjong club, although his skill is only average.

He drinks about as much as an ordinary person, but Sayaka considers him a lightweight.

Whenever he drinks with Sayaka, he is always the first one to get drunk and pass out.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
